systems.boundary: March scaled IFBFat precedes migration start in 62 temporally safe animal-years and predicts standardized start in the frozen primary slope. In the same subset, DFP_Start retains signed associations with movement speed and stopover after accounting for IFBFat, while IFBFat intervals include zero in both downstream actuator models. A prespecified DFP_Start x IFBFat moderation test supports neither actuator (interaction CIs include zero and point estimates are opposite the readiness-gating predictions). This supports T3_CANDIDATE + D2 -> H1_CANDIDATE with channel dissociation, but H2 is not supported by the IFBFat proxy; year-FE/rank readiness sensitivities are weaker and G/O/K/g/phi/Q remain unidentified.

global_boundary: Mule deer are the strongest same-system H1 candidate (T3_CANDIDATE + D2) and show source-backed channel dissociation between predeparture physiological condition and postdeparture signed phase correction. A prespecified IFBFat moderation test did not support H2 gating. No current PAYOFF-B natural system identifies H2 readiness-gated feedback or a full G/O/K/g/phi/Q decomposition.
